description: This file contains the implementation of the InsideRuntimeClient class, which manages runtime interactions for system grains within the Orleans distributed application framework. It handles message sending, invocation, response processing, callback management, and lifecycle participation, serving as a core component for grain runtime communication.

classes.name: InsideRuntimeClient
classes.description: A core class managing runtime message handling, invocation, and lifecycle participation for Orleans system grains.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request message to a target grain, registering callbacks and handling message metadata.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message back to the requester, with logging and expiration checks.

methods.name: ReceiveResponse
methods.description: Processes incoming response messages, handling rejections, status updates, and callback invocation.

methods.name: CreateObjectReference
methods.description: Creates a remote object reference for an IAddressable object, if in a valid context.

methods.name: DeleteObjectReference
methods.description: Deletes a remote object reference for an IAddressable object, if in a valid context.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the runtime client to lifecycle events for initialization and shutdown.

methods.name: BreakOutstandingMessagesToSilo
methods.description: Marks all outstanding messages to a specified dead silo as failed.

methods.name: GetRunningRequestsCount
methods.description: Returns the number of active requests for a specific grain interface type.
